preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 100
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each test case starts with two space-separated odd integers o1 and o2, where o1 * o2 = N (number of districts).

preconditions.expression: all(o1 % 2 == 1 and o2 % 2 == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2] for o1, o2 in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: o1 and o2 are odd positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == o1 * o2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2] for o1, o2 in [stdin.splitlines()[i][:2] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2)])
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains exactly N = o1 * o2 space-separated integers (0 or 1).

preconditions.expression: all(d in {0, 1} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2] for d in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each district representative is either 0 (Zero) or 1 (One).

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in {'0', '1'} for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is either '0' or '1', indicating whether the President can be a One (1) or not (0).
Each output line is exactly one character ('0' or '1').
The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda o1, o2, districts: any(all(sum(districts[i:i+o2]) > o2 // 2 for i in range(N)) for N in [o1 * o2] for districts in [list(map(int, districts.split()))] for start in range(o2) for state_governors in [sum(districts[(i + start) % N : (i + start + o1 * o2) % N : o2] for i in range(o1))] if state_governors > o1 // 2))(o1, o2, districts) == (output_line == '1') for o1, o2, districts in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][::2]], [line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][1::2]]) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is '1' if and only if there exists a way to partition the districts into o1 states of o2 consecutive districts (circularly) such that the majority of state governors are Ones. A state governor is a One if the majority of its districts are Ones, and the President is a One if the majority of state governors are Ones.
